## What is the bug?

A clear description of what is going wrong.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. See error

## Expected behavior

What should have happened instead?

## Actual behavior

What actually happened?

## Screenshots or console errors

If applicable, add screenshots or paste any errors from the browser console (open with `F12` → Console tab).

## Environment

- Browser: (e.g. Chrome 124, Firefox 126, Safari 17)
- OS: (e.g. Windows 11, macOS 14)
- Did this work before? (yes / no / unsure)

## Additional context

Any other information that might help — e.g. does it happen every time or only sometimes, does clearing localStorage fix it, etc.
